- Synthetic benchmarks run (25 docs)
- Knowledge transfer: `samples/memories/2025-12-29-session-knowledge-transfer-perf-tuning-baseline.md`

## Immediate Next Step
Run the full benchmark suite on the real corpus to establish baseline:

```bash
python -m benchmarks.corpus.runner --all --use-corpus corpus_dev.json --output benchmarks/results/baseline.json
```

## Scientific Method
1. Establish baseline FIRST (no code changes)
2. Analyze data to find actual bottlenecks
3. Form hypothesis with predicted improvement
4. Make ONE change
5. Re-measure and compare
